_note: Pinned against kasm-session-runtime's v0.2.96-rc.1 tag (pre-release). This tag adds the human-in-the-loop channel (docs/human-in-the-loop.md): a run-scoped inbox behind KASM_RUNTIME_INBOX_TOKEN with messages, attachments, typed requests answered through the sidebar's new Inbox tab, ask_human for the agent, stop and finish_handoff control actions; launch.on_error_dialog: continue so a benign post-launch dialog opens the loop instead of ending the run (wine-assess OI-045); and the sidebar documented as two contracts (docs/sidebar-hosting.md, docs/sidebar-protocol.md). The sidebar bundle in this tag carries the Inbox tab. Nothing changes for a run without an inbox token. The sidebar (pkgs/kasm-ai-runtime-sidebar) is pinned to the same commit -- bump both together. Hashes computed by downloading both published objects (curl) and taking sha256-<base64 of the raw SHA-256 digest>, the same value nix's fixed-output check computes for a fetchurl. Re-pin the same way: download kasm-session-runtime-linux-<amd64|arm64>.<tag>.<short> and kasm-ai-runtime-sidebar.tar.gz.<tag>.<short>, hash, update.
